name: mcp.schedule.add
rests_on: Klanker reminder add: fixed text or a routine prompt, exit 0 = added

text.description: Reminder text. Delivered on the job channel when that channel can send; otherwise kept local.

at.description: Due time: relative like '+10m' or ISO datetime

name.description: Optional short slug/identifier for the schedule

channel.description: Target channel (http, telegram, local, …). Uses the current turn channel when omitted.

user.description: Target user on that channel. Inherited from the current turn when omitted.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for naive ISO datetimes and cron (for example UTC). Inherited when omitted.

prompt.description: Routine prompt. Runs a full Klanker turn in session routine:<name>. Reply NO_UPDATE to stay quiet. Omit for a fixed-text reminder (use text instead).
